# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project

Laravel 13 + Inertia.js v3 + React 19 application, bootstrapped from the `laravel/blank-react-starter-kit`. PHP 8.4, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4. The app is currently at a near-skeleton stage: a single route (`/` → `welcome` page), the default `User` model, and no custom controllers yet.

**See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the full Laravel Boost guideline set (auto-generated by `laravel/boost`)** — package/version pins, Boost MCP tool usage, and per-package conventions (Inertia, Wayfinder, Pint, Pest). This file adds project-specific commands and architecture notes on top of that; don't duplicate what's already in AGENTS.md.

## Product & domain planning

The application code is still a skeleton, but the intended product is fully specced — **read
these before building domain features, they're the source of truth for scope and data shape**:

- [docs/PRD.md](docs/PRD.md) — product requirements: roles, domain concepts (Client/Site/Location/Asset/Contract/Work Order), and the core workflows (contract setup, scheduled & corrective maintenance, cost approval, client portal).
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — technical decisions for the domain build: the three-layout-area routing scheme (`backoffice/*`, `field/*`, client portal), the domain-driven `app/Domain/{Context}` + `resources/js/features/{context}` structure, frontend dependency choices, session vs. Passport auth split, flexible location hierarchy, chunked file uploads, and field-capture (barcode/GPS/photo) design.
- [docs/ERD.md](docs/ERD.md) — entity-relationship model (Mermaid diagram + field-level entity descriptions) to build migrations/models from.

## Commands

### PHP / Laravel

- `composer dev` — run the full local dev stack concurrently: `php artisan serve`, queue listener, and `npm run dev` (Vite).
- `composer lint` — run Pint (`pint --parallel`). Prefer `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after editing PHP files (matches AGENTS.md guidance).
- `composer lint:check` — Pint in check-only mode (`pint --parallel --test`).
- `composer types:check` — PHPStan/Larastan (`phpstan analyse`, level 7).
- `composer test` — clears config cache, then runs `lint:check`, `types:check`, and `php artisan test` in sequence.
- `composer ci:check` — the CI gate: `npm run lint:check`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run types:check`, then `composer test`.
- `php artisan test --compact` — run the full Pest suite. Filter a single test: `php artisan test --compact --filter=testName`.
- `php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/ExampleTest.php` — run one test file.
- `php artisan route:list` — inspect routes; filter with `--method=`, `--name=`, `--path=`.
- PHPStan/Larastan level is 7, scoped to `app/`, `bootstrap/app.php`, `config/`, `database/`, `routes/` (see [phpstan.neon](phpstan.neon)).

### JS / Frontend

- `npm run dev` — Vite dev server.
- `npm run build` / `npm run build:ssr` — production build (SSR variant also builds the SSR bundle).
- `npm run lint` / `npm run lint:check` — ESLint (fix / check-only).
- `npm run format` / `npm run format:check` — Prettier over `resources/`.
- `npm run types:check` — `tsc --noEmit`.

## Architecture

- **Inertia, not a JSON API.** Pages are React components under `resources/js/pages/`, rendered server-side via `Route::inertia(...)` or `Inertia::render()` from controllers in `app/Http/Controllers/`. There is no client-side router — navigation and props flow through Inertia. `routes/api.php` exists only for the `laravel/passport`-backed `/user` endpoint; new server-driven pages should go through the per-area route files (see below) + Inertia, not the API, unless building an actual external API.
- **Wayfinder generates the TS/route glue.** `resources/js/actions/` and `resources/js/routes/` are auto-generated by `@laravel/vite-plugin-wayfinder` (wired in [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts)) from PHP controllers and named routes. Don't hand-edit files under `resources/js/actions/` or `resources/js/routes/` — change the PHP controller/route and rebuild instead. Import controller-bound helpers from `@/actions/...` and named-route helpers from `@/routes/...`.
- **Domain-driven structure, as domain features land.** Per ARCHITECTURE.md §3–6: business logic groups by bounded context (`Client`, `Asset`, `Contract`, `WorkOrder`, `Calibration`, `Approval`, `Identity`) — Eloquent models stay flat in `app/Models/`, controllers/requests group into `app/Http/{Controllers,Requests}/{Context}/`, and business logic (Actions/DTOs/Policies/Notifications) lives in `app/Domain/{Context}/`. On the frontend, `resources/js/pages/` stays thin and routing-only; domain markup/logic lives in `resources/js/features/{context}/{components,lib,hooks}`. Routes split per layout area: `routes/backoffice.php`, `routes/field.php`, `routes/portal.php`.
- **Styling helper:** `cn()` in `resources/js/lib/utils.ts` (clsx + tailwind-merge) is the standard way to compose conditional Tailwind classes; Prettier is configured to sort Tailwind classes inside `clsx`, `cn`, and `cva` calls.
- **Frontend dependencies to add as domain features land** (see ARCHITECTURE.md §5 for rationale): shadcn/ui for components, Inertia's `useForm` for forms (no RHF/zod), `@zxing/browser` for barcode scanning, `date-fns` for date formatting, `vite-plugin-pwa` for installability, `pionl/laravel-chunk-upload` + `resumable.js` for chunked file uploads. No client-state/query library, no i18n library, no charting library, no frontend test framework — deliberate MVP omissions, not oversights.
- **App bootstrap:** `resources/js/app.tsx` calls `createInertiaApp` — this is the SPA entry point; page title formatting and Inertia progress-bar config live here.
- **Testing:** Pest (v5) is layered on PHPUnit; test suites are `tests/Unit` and `tests/Feature` per [phpunit.xml](phpunit.xml). SQLite in-memory DB, array session/cache drivers, and sync queue are used for tests (see the `<php>` env block in phpunit.xml) — no external services needed to run the suite.
- **Defaults set in `AppServiceProvider`:** dates use `CarbonImmutable`; destructive DB commands are prohibited outside production; password complexity rules (`Password::defaults`) only apply in production.
- **Auth:** `laravel/passport` is installed for OAuth2/API token auth (see the `/user` route in `routes/api.php` guarded by `auth:api`); no first-party session auth scaffolding exists yet.

## Conventions

- Follow existing sibling-file structure and naming when adding controllers, models, migrations, or pages — this repo is still small, so precedent is thin; lean on the Laravel/Inertia/Wayfinder conventions in AGENTS.md.
- Use `php artisan make:*` commands for new Laravel files, and `php artisan make:test --pest {name}` for new tests (feature tests by default; pass `--unit` for unit tests).
- Don't create new top-level directories or add dependencies without checking with the user first.
- **Language convention**: all code and database artifacts (tables, columns, enum values, class/function/variable names, comments) are written in English; all user-facing UI text (labels, buttons, messages, notifications) is written in Bahasa Indonesia. See [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for an example.
- **Shadcn/ui skill**: before writing or editing any React UI component (anything under `resources/js/components`, `resources/js/features/*/components`, `resources/js/layouts`, or `resources/js/pages`), activate the `shadcn` skill first — it enforces this project's component conventions (composition over hand-rolled markup, semantic color tokens, `cn()` usage, form/icon patterns). Full rules live in `.agents/skills/shadcn/`.
